key_insight: BrReMark adds explicit region marking and verification to brain MRI diagnosis, helping the model ground findings in image evidence instead of relying on a single-pass guess.
clinical_relevance: This could make MRI AI outputs more auditable and potentially reduce hallucinated abnormalities, especially on normal or rare-case scans.
method: Hypothesis first, then mark suspected regions with bounding boxes
Re-examine the marked evidence before final diagnosis
Train with supervised reasoning trajectories plus reinforcement learning, and add synthetic pathology augmentation for OOD robustness
evidence_signal: On the internal benchmark, the method raised mAP50 from 0.74% to 37.54%, and on NOVA it reduced false positives by 45.7% while maintaining competitive overall performance.
watch_item: The reported gains come from benchmark evaluation, so real-world clinical reliability, annotation burden, and performance across diverse scanners and hospitals still need validation.
paper_title: Enhancing Brain MRI Anomaly Detection and Reasoning with ROI Rethink and Synthetic Data
